title: WaterColor 105 Park Row Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Spectacular Gulf views- Located just steps from the WaterColor Beach Club- Open floor plan- Luxury primary suite- Stainless steel appliances- GE high-efficiency washer/dryer- Wine refrigerator- Gas grill- 6 adult bikes- Garage with electric car plug-in- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Charmed days of coastal fun await at 105 Park Row Lane! This beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom WaterColor home accommodates up to 10 guests and is only a 2-minute stroll from WaterColor Beach Club and beach access! Enjoy relaxed days lying on the beach, taking advantage of the numerous community pools, footpaths, and tennis courts, or exploring the nearby Emerald Coast neighborhoods.Soothing natural hues, tongue-and-groove walls, and warm hardwood floors come together for a harmonious, cottage-style interior in the great room on this home’s main level. In the living area, sink back into the deep couches and plush armchairs surrounding a TV and DVD player for a relaxing night with friends and family. To the side is a wood table with 6 chairs beneath a Capiz shell chandelier. Culinary-inspired guests will love the high-end appliances and ample counter space in the L-shaped kitchen, complete with a 4-stool breakfast bar and wine cooler. Head out to the attached balcony for a leisurely lunch at the 6-person patio table or curl up in the shaded porch swing while enjoying views of the bright turquoise Gulf waters. This level of the home hosts a kid-friendly bunk room with 1 set of twin-over-twin beds and 1 set of XL twin-over-twin beds.On the ground level, guests can enjoy a restful night in either of the 2 guest bedrooms—each outfitted with a king bed and private bathroom. A laundry room adds convenience for extended stays. Additionally, there’s a propane grill and an extra refrigerator beside the door for barbecuing!Venture to the top floor to discover the roomy primary bedroom featuring a king bed, cozy sitting area, private bathroom, and a secluded balcony.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with shower only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with shower/tub comboSECOND FLOOR:- Bunk Room: L-shaped bunk with One Set of Twin over Twin Bunks and One Set of Twin-XL over Twin-XL Bunks, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Suite: King Bed, Walk-In Closet, Sitting Area, Private Bathroom with walk-in shower*Parties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. Fees apply. Contact us for additional details.*Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home, and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
